aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, then set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. The total capacity limits orders across all selected categories so if you want to only sell a maximum of 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, then set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. This will still keep your mains restricted to 4 items every 5 minutes.

managePayments.state.pending.body: Nothing for you to do. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page updates when they’re done.
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Get in touch and we will sort it out with you.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as your online payments — a card reader, or contactless straight from your phone or tablet.

manageReports.accounts.partial: Dishes without a cost are left out of the cost, so this profit is higher than it really is. Add a cost to each dish in Menu.

manageSettings.vans.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card” so your takings reconcile against the till. You can turn this on for a single event from the dashboard.

manageTeam.modal.roleManager: Manager — Full access including menu and settings
manageTeam.modal.roleOwner: Owner — Full access including team and billing
manageTeam.privacy: Your personal details are private and never shown to customers. They’re used for account management and billing verification.
manageTeam.verifyNote: A verification link will be sent to this address. Your current email remains active until verified.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends for you is billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta includes {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app aren’t charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s pricing</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from} the first {free, number} a month are free. Correct at {checked}; check <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you will still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customer questions automatically on your social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. Will require an Instagram professional account.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your truck.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script could not load. An ad blocker or tracking protection is the usual cause.
manageWhatsApp.preview.intro: Type a question like a customer would ask, and see exactly what they’d get back. Nothing is sent to anyone.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not turn on message delivery. Your setup is saved — please contact support rather than running it again.
nativeShell.binary.cameraUsage: HatchGrab uses the camera so you can photograph your menu board, your dishes and other documents and upload them straight into your account. Images are used only for the uploads you choose to make.

nativeShell.notify.refused: Notifications need to be enabled in your device Settings to turn this on.
nativeShell.setup.fetchErrorBody: We couldn’t reach the server to set up this device. Check the connection and try again — your orders and settings are unaffected.
nativeShell.setup.noVanBody: This truck has no active van yet. Activate one in Settings → Your trucks, then this device sets up automatically — no further steps here.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Disable offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders will continue — customers may place orders you cannot see. Only disable if you have a reliable connection.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection enabled.

To keep orders flowing, your screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection takes over in the mode you chose.

Make sure Screen On is enabled on this device.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen goes off, the device loses internet, or you switch to another website, offline protection takes over — either pausing ordering or turning auto-accept off, whichever you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Keep your dashboard or kitchen screen on and online during service, or offline protection may take over.
